text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrives for Yaeno Muteki. I give it to her when I see her at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fan letters encapsulate the devotion of those who support me. They must be read with the utmost care and respect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking solemn, Yaeno Muteki opens the letter and begins reading.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki suddenly lets out a shout… and then runs from the room!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I chase her to the rooftop, where I find her furiously striking the air with her fists.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaa! Seeei! Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…
choice_data_list: The letter didn't say anything mean, did it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Not at all! The exact opposite!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sender is a student of the Kongo Yaegaki style, just as I am.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The reason I chose the path of racing was because my master instructed me to do so. But, as you'd expect, not all of my fellow students agreed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Why are you doing this?! You said we were gonna dedicate ourselves to martial arts together! You're a big liar, Yae!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There's no denying that I broke the promise I made to her. I've dedicated myself to a routine of stringent training to ensure I don't forget that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But in her letter, she said…

text_block_list.name: Letter from Classmate
text_block_list.text: I was so angry with you for the longest time. I thought you'd just run away from martial arts to do your own thing, leaving me behind.

text_block_list.name: Letter from Classmate
text_block_list.text: But when I saw you running on TV, I realized something. You're still walking your path with honor.

text_block_list.name: Letter from Classmate
text_block_list.text: As Adept once said, "It is not enough to simply accept the comings and goings of others. You must greet them with warmth and see them off with kindness."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Classmate
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for saying such awful things to you before. I know it might be too late, but I want you to have a warm goodbye from me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am… struggling to find the words to express my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So I shall let my emotions burst forth from my fists, ride the winds, race through the heavens, and find their way to you, my friend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having received a letter from an old friend, Yaeno Muteki renews her vow to push ahead down the path of racing.
